The '''Vordebeast''' was a non-sentient predatory creature that lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Following the [[Bequest]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] attempted to recruit the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to kill her grandmother [[Vilia Calimondra]], the matriarch of the [[Calimondra family]]. During the meeting, Kerra likened the Sith woman's movements to that of a "vordebeast" as she maneuvered through the [[Arkadia's museum|museum's]] pylons.
